prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to pick up an empty uncapped test tube from test tube rack 2 and move it to dispensing device to draw silicone solution.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: test tube rack 2
What the inspection checks: Check whether there is an empty uncapped test tube on test tube rack 2.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: The image appears rotated roughly 90°. A white perforated optical/breadboard-style panel fills most of the frame, dotted with regularly spaced mounting holes and threaded inserts.

Across the middle runs a horizontal assembly: a black rectangular rack or holder block with six circular openings (wells/ports) in a row, mounted on a light grey aluminium extrusion rail with T-slots and end brackets. The openings appear dark and empty; no vials, tubes or liquid are discernible in them.

Upper area: a grey plastic housing with a knob or fitting, and a black cable running to a small black connector block.

Right edge: pale grey equipment housings and white angled arms/brackets. Lower left: a white plate and a partially visible printed marker.
observations: The inspection camera description indicates that the circular openings on the rack appear dark and empty, with no test tubes present on test tube rack 2.
